_comment: Preconfigured LED strip systems the local PC webcam calibrator can target. Pick one with: python led_calibrator.py --system <name>. HTTP is required (the service is cumulonimbus2001.py running on the target). SSH is optional and only used to (re)start the service remotely.

ssh.note: Optional. Only used with --remote-start to launch the service before calibrating.

localhost-sim.description: cumulonimbus2001.py running locally with the off-Pi simulator (for dev/testing the pipeline without a real Pi).
